description: The commandmate CLI subcommands and options the cmate-orchestrate runners are allowed to use, transcribed verbatim from `commandmate <cmd> --help` (CommandMate 0.17.0). The fake CLI enforces this surface and the contract-parity test asserts the runners only ever call subcommands/flags listed here — so a runner that reaches for a non-existent flag (the #1467 regression) fails the suite instead of only failing in production. When a real `commandmate` binary is on PATH the parity test additionally checks these flags are a subset of the live `--help`.
version_gating: `since` marks a subcommand, and `since_flags` marks individual flags, that a specific CommandMate version introduced (Issue #1588: the execution contract and the contract verdict both arrived in 0.17.0). The live `--help` parity check skips those entries when the installed binary predates them, and says out loud which ones it skipped — an older CLI legitimately does not list them, and asserting anyway would report a supported fallback as a contract drift. Entries with no `since` are asserted against every version.
